title: La mise à l'échelle du Dossier Patient Informatisé dans la DPG du Premier Ministre M. Ousmane SONKO

why_not: An undated extract of a policy declaration saying the record, already available, will be scaled up region by region; a plan statement on an aspect with no gap, and nothing on where the record is digitised.
